**Hey Solid Community 👋** Quick update on **solid-mobile** — a mobile UI component library for Solid.js. Some of you may have seen it before; for everyone else, here's the short version:

**solid-mobile** (v0.2.3) — 55+ components · theme system · i18n · dark mode · fully typed · zero runtime deps · 590+ tests

**Recent:** new components (ChatMessage, Skeleton, TreeSelect, Form system), dozens of bug fixes, test suite at zero failures.

**Now:** quality-first, no new components before 1.0. The docs site is becoming a real consumer of the published npm package (every demo verifies the actual release), and the full test suite becomes a CI gate.

**API locks at 1.0** (additive-only after)
